verdict.rationale: Zoho Books documents bank feeds, transaction categorization, bank reconciliation creation/listing, bank statement summaries, and bank rules for matching, which together support surfacing matched/unmatched items during reconciliation; accountant collaboration is also documented. However, there is no explicit description of a duplicate-transaction detection/review UI or a dedicated reconciliation screen showing matched vs unmatched vs duplicate buckets. missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of duplicate-transaction flagging, a unified reconciliation review screen showing matched/unmatched/duplicate side-by-side, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of the reconciliation workflow.
